en: (<Color:8>Grilled Pig's Feet<Color:Default>, huh... I wonder how that is.)
Hey, could I get a <Color:8>Fried Ramen<Color:Default>?
(<Color:8>Fried Ramen<Color:Default>, huh... I guess that's on the menu, too.)
Welcome. What'll ya be havin'?
Thanks. I hope you come again!
You here to help out? I sure could use a hand.
Sorry, something came up.
Ah, my apologies. I've got some business to attend to.
Can't right now, but best of luck to ya.
Ooh, sorry. I kinda got this thing to do... Yeah...
I'm so sorry. I actually have to be somewhere right now.
Hey, Uncle Kaz! <Color:8>See if you can score more than 250 points in single-player count-up!<Color:Default>
(Haruka wants me to <Color:8>score at least 250 points in count-up<Color:Default>.)
Aww, okay. Well, maybe you can play <Color:8>darts<Color:Default> next time.
Excuse me, but are you underage? I'm sorry, but I can't serve you any alcohol.
Welcome. What can I get for you?
Thank you. Please take care.
Sure. What can I get you?
Sure. What would you like to sell?
Wow, there are so many brand name goods here! I didn't know people sold them at places like this.
Ya got anythin' you could sell?
Quite a few things actually, but it's such a pain to haul them all the way to the store. I wind up just selling them online.
We're back to this again?
What's so bad about it? It's convenient. Plus, stores like this drive a hard bargain, so selling them here hardly makes a good profit.
They're experts, after all. They know if something's not rare because it's a resale, or won't sell because it's unpopular.
But, people less knowledgeable about this sort of thing will pay good prices for stuff they could get cheaper elsewhere.
Ya sure know how to make money. Maybe you should quit bein' a hostess and do that instead.
Oh, no. I mean I've thought about it some, but opening my own store would require me to acquire a lot of merchandise first.
Well, yeah. Sellin' stuff ya don't actually have is nothin' but a scam.
But that would mean I would need to search high and low for things I can get for a low price.
Ya gotta if you're tryin' to start a business. If yer just sellin' stuff ya got at home, you'll run outta inventory real fast.
Well, I don't like walking around outside, so I couldn't do that. It would be great if I could do everything from home.
You really don't wanna work, do ya? But I guess that's better than divin' into somethin' with no thought put in.
That's a scam. Sellin' things for more than ya know they're worth is a rip-off.
No, it isn't. The seller doesn't decide what an item is worth⑬ the buyer does.
Huh? Whaddya mean?
It's like... Okay, you know how the food and drinks at a cabaret club are more expensive than it would be at other places?
Yeah, they're way too much.
Right. But people order it anyway, if they think it's worth it. They decide whether something has an appropriate return based on its price.
I get ya. Spendin' more than ya normally would gives that somethin' a sorta special meanin'.
Exactly! How astute of you, Saejima-san!
Heh, you're smarter than I woulda thought. Maybe that makes ya pretty valuable.
I should give it a shot. I wonder if I got anythin' I don't need.
Hmm. Is there anything that you collect, Saejima-san?
Collectables, huh? I've got my woodwork dolls that I made. I've never shown 'em to anyone, but I think I did a good job makin' 'em.
Oh wow, art! I think trying to sell some of those would be a great idea.
Yeah, but how much would I sell one of 'em for? I've never bought one, so I dunno how much they're worth.
Maybe you should bring one of them to this shop sometime. You can find out how much they'll buy it for here.
Oh, that's smart! Next time I'll hafta bring one.
I hope you get a good price for it!
Welcome. Can I help you find anything today?
Oh, maybe that <Color:8>Caviar Skin Bag<Color:Default>! It's even cheaper than it would be at a name brand store!
(Guess Kaguya wants that <Color:8>Caviar Skin Bag<Color:Default>.)
All right, what can I get for you?
All right, what can I take off your hands?
Two.
Huh? My money's already gone.
What!? You already spent the 10 million!?
Geez! All right, once again, imagine yourself loaded with money!
Yeah, sorry.
You imagine having another <Color:8>100,000 yen<Color:Default>.
1,000 yen please. Thank you very much. Have a good time.
This was so much fun! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default> I want to just head straight home now! But I have to make sure nobody from Rose Hip sees me.
Very well. If you'd follow me please.
Sorry. I've got to get going.
Come on, I was in Tokyo! And you had to call me back to Sapporo for this? We could have just as easily done this in Kamurocho, you know!
That was a lot of fun, Uncle Kaz! Let's go out again soon!
Sure, let's do that.
Wow, you're real good at this, Kiryu-san! I'm kinda impressed!
Okay, I'm headin' back to Tokyo! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Welcome! It'll be 1,000 yen for the two of you. Shall I show you to your room?
Very well. Please follow me.
(I don't have enough money.)
That'll be 1,000 yen for the two of you.
In that case, it'll be 1,000 yen for two people.
Geez, why'd ya hafta call me back from Tokyo for this, Kiryu-san? Couldn't we have just gone somewhere out there?
(I can't afford the fare. Better scrounge up 550 yen...)
The base fare is 550 yen. Where are you headed?
I'm afraid you don't have enough money, sir. Please come again when you do.
Very well.
Please come again soon.
Another city? Of course, sir.
Very well, sir.
(I can't afford the fare. Better scrounge up 650 yen...)
The base fare is 650 yen. Where are you headed?
Tatsuo-kun, good afternoon! Or is it good evening already?
It's a good something, I guess. How's that back of yours?
Agonizing. No matter how much liniment I apply, it does nothing⑬and this is one of our finest products, too. Might as well be using toothpaste.
Well, you know what they say. Results may vary.
Oh, that's right, we had a few more samples come in. Thought I'd save one for you.
You got <Color:8>Staminan X<Color:Default>.

Wow, thank you! You're always so good to me. Heh, now I
don't have to worry about dinner.
Oh, dear, you can't go without eating. You're not so young anymore.
Ahaha... Truth. Oops, sorry, gotta run. Bye!
Look at that. I won.
You again, huh?
It's not like I wanna be here.
Good, because starting next month, I'm only giving prizes for course three.
That's the one with Sawada from the Gigants. No one's hit a homer on it yet.
That ought to put you in your place.
Let's see if you can prove me wrong, eh?
Nice batting.
(Oh no...)
You play baseball back in school?
Guess everyone's gotta have something they're good at.
Takasugi-san...
Come on, don't do this to me.
Why do you think I let you keep the change?
Wasn't hard to figure out what you'd do with it.
Just a moment, young man.

That man who was pitching just now⑬wasn't that Shirakawa?
Does he have some sort of bone to pick with you? He keeps
coming by and hounding me for information.
...Sounds about right.
He finally agreed to leave something on the bulletin board and get on out of here.
If you want to see the bulletin board, it's right here waiting for you. All you have to do is ask.
Okay. I'll make sure to check in with you whenever I'm here.

Shinada's Side Story pits him against fierce rivals and tough
opponents, all of them accessible via the bulletin board.

Simply speak with the batting center attendant, select your
matchup, and get slugging.

Improving your batting abilities will make it easier to
hit the ball, giving you an advantage in the batter's box.

You can improve your batting abilities by winning against
rivals or practicing on the courses at the batting center.
Oh, and there was someone else who wanted to get in contact with you too.
If you actually care about any of that, come talk to me and I'll tell you what you need to know.
Okay. I'll make sure to check in with you when I'm here.

Welcome. Oh, it's just you.
Did you know there are several people out looking for you?
I told them I had no idea where you were, so they left. If I had to guess, I'd say they were debt collectors.
That reminds me. You always leave your equipment lying around⑬would it kill you to pick up after yourself every once and again?
You again? What's it going to be this time?
(Takasugi-san's with me, so I'd rather not get sidetracked.)
Actually, I'm gonna pass for now. See ya.
You again? What's it going to be today?

Welcome. I should warn you right now, we cranked up the
difficulty to the max. Amateurs best beware.

Oh, hey, Shinada-san. Did you get my message? Well, you're
in luck. You got the last one.
Here's the stuff.

en: You got <Color:8>Toughness Emperor<Color:Default>.
Whoa, what happened to your face? Did you get into a fight?
Ahahah. Kinda sorta.

Oogh. Looks like you headbutted a beehive. Bet that stings!
...Well, I should get going. Stay out of trouble now.
(Well, I got what I came for. Now to call it a night.)
By the way, what sort of girl do you go for, Takasugi-san?
Are you serious? My wife, of course. Anyone who pays money to go to massage parlors is a damn fool, if you ask me.
I see... That's great for you.
Let's get this done. Boom and Bust is at the north end of Kumano Boulevard.
Spending the day visiting massage parlors, huh? What kind of life does this guy lead?
We're down to two choices: Boom and Bust at the north end of Kumano Boulevard, and... What was the other one?
Resort Boing. Hey, don't make me say the name out loud! I'm gonna have to wash my mouth out with soap!
Oops, sorry! Um, that's at the south end of Tsumugi Street, right?
You better not be doing that on purpose.
Boom and Bust at the north end of Kumano Boulevard, and Resort Boing at the south end of Tsumugi Street, huh?
Yeah. We'd better find Uno quick.
What makes a new girl, huh? That's a deep one.
Who gives a rat's ass? Why do I have to figure out what turns a middle-aged guy on?
I agree. So it's either Rubbe and Tucke's in front of my apartment, or Operation Panties next to Futo Momo Club. Let's go take a look.
(First, I need to get to Uno-san!)
(I can't afford the fare. Better scrounge up 480 yen...)
The base fare is 480 yen. Where to?
Yay, karaoke! Let's see, what do I want to sing today...
Can't go wrong with a Princess League song, but... There're so many others I want to sing, too!
Sounded great, Haruka.
I know, right? Hehe...
Hey, Uncle Kaz, you should sing, too! Come on, I wanna hear you sing!
Yay! This is gonna be great!
What's wrong, Haruka? Not feeling well?
Sorry, Uncle Kaz...
Nice one, Haruka. I was really getting into it.
Yeah, I nailed that one!
You made that really fun, Haruka.
You were so good, Uncle Kaz! You sounded really cool, too.
That was a tough one.
Sorry, Uncle Kaz.
You're so cool, Uncle Kaz! You sounded just like a pro!
Heh, I'm not that good.
(Now, then... What's it going to be?)
(Hmm... What to do?)
Tatsuo, are you ready now?
Yep. A-OK.
All right. Let's go, then.
Oh, hang on a minute.
You changed your mind already?
Hehe. Sorry, but can you go down first?
Nope, I'm not quite done.
Don't leave out anything you'd regret. There's no telling what's ahead.
This is no place for a little girl like you.

I'm sorry to bother you. I'm actually looking for someone,
and I think they may have been here.
(How should I ask him about Christina-san?)

Did you happen to see someone who looked like a dance
instructor?
A dance instructor? What might one look like?
Oh, I'm sorry. I guess that was a little too vague, wasn't it?

(Maybe I asked the wrong question... What if I tried asking
a different way?)
Have you seen someone who looked like a Christina?
What? I'm not sure I understand the question...
I... I guess not. I'm sorry.
(I should have said something more specific! Haruka, you idiot.)
